text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome to my garden, 
the "Queen's Tea Party."

The Twinkle Holiday Festival. Air Groove's 
"Queen's Tea Party Cafe" was bustling 
with boundless energy.
choice_data_list:
Amazing, it's packed yet running 
completely smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. While our entire staff's hard work 
is largely to thank—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We also have a brilliant commander 
orchestrating behind the scenes.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Table 3 gets drinks first. 
Seat the party of four that just entered 
in the back. 
Kitchen, start prepping additional stock 
soon.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A remarkably broad perspective, as 
expected. 
A prime example of putting the right 
person in the right place.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, you let me off floor duty, after 
all. 
Least I can do is manage the board over 
here.

text_block_list.name: Cast Member A
text_block_list.text:
W-We have a crisis! 
A multi-millionaire just walked in and 
placed a massive order! 
We're completely sold out of 
everything...!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A-A millionaire? What an absurd 
irregularity... 
However, anticipating such events, reserve 
stock 
is secured. If all hands assist with prep 
and service—

text_block_list.name: Cast Member B
text_block_list.text:
Disaster! One of the floor staff said, 
"I've been challenged to a duel!" and just 
ran off on us~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
............Huh? No, it's fine. 
I prepared for that kind of scenario too 
by keeping backup cast on standby.

text_block_list.name: Cast Member C
text_block_list.text:
We're in trouble! Rumors of the 
millionaire's buying spree 
sparked a massive crowd! And the backup 
cast ate too much 
in the eating contest and can't move~~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hold on! Where do you think you're 
going?! 
We can still turn this around!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way~~! 
Who in their right mind could beat a trash 
game like this~! 
I'm so done with this~~~~!!

The booth is visibly descending into 
chaos... 
Things clearly aren't running smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We've had a minor disruption in the chain 
of command.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—However, it's not a problem. 
We'll get back on track shortly.

Declaring this with absolute resolve, 
Air Groove briskly took her leave.

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Found it, it's here... Huh? 
Is it crowded? 
Maybe we should come back later?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Long wait times leading to 
walkouts... 
It's over, it's totally, utterly over...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. So, the primary issue is the wait 
time. 
If we address that, we can salvage this?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Pretty much... IF we even can. 
Well, I'll leave the rest to you...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hold it, Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I need your help.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your title, "Ruler of the Board," 
is by no means an overstatement.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Such titles aren't handed out to the 
undeserving. 
You earned that moniker because everyone 
recognizes your skill.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...And I am one of them. 
I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In fact, glimpses of the Ruler are already 
showing. 
Your assessment was spot-on.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You can solve this predicament. 
And I will support you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...The Queen is the most powerful piece on 
the board, 
moving as many spaces as she wants in any 
direction. 
She's not supposed to be playing 
support...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Still, if you're putting it that way...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...The staff is at max capacity. We can't 
add more exhibits. 
However... what if...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What if we add value to the waiting time? 
The quickest solution is printed material. 
Which means...—

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, excuse me...! 
Is this the right answer to the logic 
puzzle 
handed out in the waiting line...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Impressive. You managed to solve that 
difficulty level, 
[Ruler of the Board].

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then hand me your invitation. 
I shall grace it with my signature.

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
An autograph from Air Groove-san!?!? 
I-I'm so glad I wracked my brain over 
that...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then, staff, guide our guest inside. 
...Please, enjoy your stay.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Didn't I tell you? 
It wouldn't be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Unforeseen complications are inevitable. 
As long as we account for them, this is 
the result.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! 
The customers won't leave the line now... 
Checkmate, this game is ours!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Though perhaps we should prepare for 
any backlash, too.
choice_data_list:
You really place your trust in everyone 
here, don't you?

You're more than capable of backing them 
up, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I place my trust in everyone here— 
each and every one of them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —You hardly needed to ask.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
............ 
You really are carefree.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose that, too, is a form of 
trust.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I shall do my utmost...
